# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Security Affairs window refresh marker.
# Update 22.11.2026: guarded against the scope-less on_startup pass (is_ai invalid scope spam in error.log).
# Generated by tools/colonial_affairs/ui_dirty.py.
COLDWAR_COL_ui_mark_dirty = {
	hidden_effect = {
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — 22.11.2026: on_startup has no ROOT; skip the UI marker there (no window is open at startup).
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_no_root_pass = 1 } } }
			ROOT = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_ui_dirty = 1 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_ui_dirty > 100000 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_ui_dirty = 1 } }
			}
		}
		}
	}
}
